name: Braiin Limited Common Stock
description: Braiin Ltd is an Australian technology company leveraging proprietary intellectual property and patented artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) technologies to deliver actionable insights across the verticals: Agriculture, Property Technology, and Customer Experience as a Service (CXaaS). The company's platforms are designed to address inefficiencies and drive data-backed decision-making across traditionally analog sectors. It prominently focuses on the agriculture technology sector, where it has successfully deployed its AI-powered solutions across multiple implementations. It provides end-to-end solutions to improve farming productivity using IoTs, Wireless Connectivity, Robotics, Software and AI/ML.
